speaker: Narrator
text: You push through the bushes, following the hedgehog deeper into the forest.

speaker: You
text: Where did it go?

speaker: Narrator
text: The forest is strangely quiet. You look around, trying to spot the hedgehog.

speaker: You
text: Hello?

speaker: Tui
text: Looking for someone?

speaker: You
text: AH! What the heck where did that come from??

speaker: Narrator
text: You look up and see a tūī sitting on a branch above you.

speaker: You
text: You... you can talk??

speaker: Tui
text: Of course I can talk.

speaker: You
text: No. Birds don't talk.

speaker: Tui
text: And yet, here we are.

speaker: You
text: ...Right.

speaker: Tui
text: You were following the hedgehog, weren't you?

speaker: You
text: Yeah. It ran across the road.

speaker: Tui
text: It was trying to get to the other side.

speaker: You
text: Why didn't it just stay in the forest?

speaker: Tui
text: Because the road cuts straight through its home.

speaker: You
text: So it had to cross the road?

speaker: Tui
text: Exactly.

speaker: Tui
text: When roads, buildings, and other things split up an animal's habitat, we call it habitat fragmentation.

speaker: You
text: So the road is basically separating the forest?

speaker: Tui
text: Yes. And that can make it harder for animals to find food, shelter, and each other.

speaker: You
text: I never really thought about it like that.

speaker: Tui
text: Most people don't.

speaker: Tui
text: They see a road. We see something standing between us and where we need to go.

speaker: You
text: So that's why I keep seeing animals crossing?

speaker: Tui
text: Partly.

speaker: Tui
text: The road doesn't just affect one animal. It affects everything living around it.

speaker: You
text: Then... what am I supposed to do?

speaker: Tui
text: Pay attention.

speaker: Tui
text: Slow down. Look out for animals. And remember that the road is passing through their home too.

speaker: You
text: I guess I'll have to keep my eyes open.

speaker: Tui
text: That's a good start.

speaker: Narrator
text: The tūī suddenly spreads its wings and flies deeper into the forest.

speaker: You
text: Wait! Where are you going?
